   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      19 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 8 jun 2026 - 25 sept 2026

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**

            2. _PatronOfSoftwareArts_, 24 sept 2026, 1/5: "Crashes upon launch every time on iOS 27. Saw a very clever ad, so I decided to download this app. Impossible to use as it crashes every single time."
            3. _A136P_, 24 sept 2026, 1/5: "I was using this app for over a year and really liked it. At some point that had a huge system update and since then it would glitch constantly and lag. I have ended up deleting it as a result"
